detail.title: The Effect of Tax Abatement Disclosure on Municipal Financing
detail.abstract: Local governments’ use of tax incentives (abatements) is both economically significant and politically controversial. However, government disclosures about tax abatements have historically been sparse or opaque, making it difficult for external parties to assess the magnitude, scope, and economic effects of these incentives. Utilizing the adoption of Governmental Accounting Standards Board Statement 77 (GASB 77), which requires local governments adhering to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) to disclose information about tax abatements, we investigate how mandatory abatement disclosures affect municipal financing costs. We find that the adoption of GASB 77 is associated with a significant reduction in the cost of bonds issued by affected counties. Additional analyses suggest this effect is not only a function of reduced information asymmetry or broader increases in scrutiny resulting from enhanced disclosure, but also of the nature of the disclosed tax abatement information.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用GASB 77会计准则的实施，发现强制性税收减免披露与县级政府债券融资成本显著降低相关。
AI.research_question: 强制性税收减免披露如何影响市政融资成本？
AI.motivation: 地方政府税收减免在经济上意义重大且政治争议性强，但相关披露历来稀疏或不透明，使外部难以评估这些激励措施的规模、范围和经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、政府透明度理论、市政融资理论
AI.method: 利用GASB 77会计准则的采用作为准自然实验，分析强制性税收减免披露对县级政府债券融资成本的影响。
AI.findings: GASB 77的采用与受影响县发行的债券成本显著降低相关。这种效应不仅源于信息不对称减少或披露增强带来的审查增加，还与披露的税收减免信息性质有关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为强制性信息披露对政府融资成本的影响提供了实证证据，深化了对政府透明度机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于税收减免披露重要性的实证支持，有助于改善地方政府财政管理和投资者决策。

title: Evaluating the Efficacy of AI-Driven Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention for Managing Body Fluid Imbalances in Sickle Cell Disease in Sub-Saharan Africa

detail.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of AI-Driven Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention for Managing Body Fluid Imbalances in Sickle Cell Disease in Sub-Saharan Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: This study will test a new AI-powered system designed to help manage sickle cell disease (SCD) in Sub-Saharan Africa. SCD is a devastating genetic disorder, and dehydration is a major trigger for painful and dangerous complications called vasoocclusive crises (VOCs). Current monitoring methods are not effective in regions with limited healthcare access. The research will use a randomized controlled trial, the gold standard for testing medical interventions. It will involve 600 participants aged 12-45 from Nigeria, Ghana, and Tanzania. They will be randomly split into two groups. The intervention group will use a special kit that includes wearable sensors (like a smartwatch) to track heart rate and activity, a smart water bottle that measures how much they drink, and a smartphone app. An AI algorithm will analyze this data in realtime to provide personalized hydration alerts. The control group will receive standard education on hydration and use a traditional water bottle and diary. The main goal is to see if the AI system reduces the number of VOCs requiring medical care over 24 months. Secondary goals include measuring its impact on other complications, quality of life, healthcare costs, and how easy the system is to use. The study is designed for real-world conditions in Africa, with a focus on community input and a system that works even with poor internet. Strengths include its rigorous design and multi-country approach. A key limitation is that participants will know which group they are in. If successful, this research could transform SCD care from reactive to proactive, saving lives and providing a model for managing other diseases in lowresource settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试一种新型AI系统，用于管理撒哈拉以南非洲地区的镰状细胞病(SCD)。该系统通过可穿戴传感器、智能水瓶和手机应用实时监测患者数据，AI算法提供个性化补水提醒，旨在减少需要医疗护理的血管闭塞危象(VOCs)发生次数。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的监测系统是否能有效减少撒哈拉以南非洲地区镰状细胞病患者需要医疗护理的血管闭塞危象(VOCs)发生次数？
AI.motivation: SCD是一种毁灭性遗传疾病，脱水是引发疼痛和危险并发症(VOCs)的主要诱因。在医疗资源有限的地区，现有监测方法效果不佳，需要开发适合当地条件的创新解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实时监测和个性化干预的预防性医疗模式，结合行为改变理论和远程医疗概念。
AI.method: 随机对照试验，涉及600名12-45岁来自尼日利亚、加纳和坦桑尼亚的参与者，分为干预组(使用AI系统)和对照组(标准教育)，为期24个月。
AI.findings: 研究将评估AI系统在减少VOCs、改善生活质量、降低医疗成本等方面的效果，但目前尚未完成。
AI.theory_contributions: 为低资源环境下慢性疾病管理提供理论框架，验证AI驱动的预防性医疗模式在现实条件下的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发适合非洲现实条件的SCD管理工具，为其他疾病在低资源环境下的管理提供可复制模型，推动从被动治疗向主动预防的医疗模式转变。

title: Environmental Framing and Moral Preferences in Portfolio Choice: Evidence from a Lab-in-the-Field Experiment
affiliations: MBS School of Business, Université Montpellier I, Université Montpellier I and University of Montpellier

detail.title: Environmental Framing and Moral Preferences in Portfolio Choice: Evidence from a Lab-in-the-Field Experiment
detail.abstract: This paper examines how financial return, risk, and environmental impact jointly shape portfolio choices in a lab-in-the-field experiment involving more than 15,000 decisions made by finance professionals and university students. Participants repeatedly allocated budgets among green, neutral, and brown assets that differed in expected return and risk. Asset color represented real environmental externalities, operationalized as actual donations either to a pro-environmental NGO (green) or to a fossil fuel association (brown).Three robust findings emerge. First, environmental framing alters financial sensitivities: participants react more strongly to return changes in greener assets, while risk sensitivity remains unaffected by asset color. In high-risk contexts, portfolios shift toward higher-return brown assets, indicating that standard return–risk trade-offs dominate when financial risk rises. Second, preferences are asymmetric—aversion to brown assets outweighs attraction to green ones—consistent with loss aversion and negativity bias. Third, both professionals and students exhibit pro-environmental tendencies, though for distinct reasons: professionals’ allocations reflect trading experience and job-related heuristics, whereas students’ choices are more strongly linked to pro-social and environmental attitudes and respond more to both pecuniary and moral incentives.

AI.tldr: 通过实地实验研究金融专业人士和大学生在投资组合选择中如何平衡财务回报、风险和环境影响的决策行为，发现环境框架会改变财务敏感性，对棕色资产的厌恶超过对绿色资产的偏好，且专业人士和学生表现出不同的环保投资动机。
AI.research_question: 财务回报、风险和环境影响因素如何共同塑造投资组合选择？
AI.motivation: 理解投资者在可持续投资决策中如何权衡财务因素与环境因素，以及不同背景投资者的决策差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、损失厌恶理论、负面偏见、启发式决策
AI.method: 实地实验室实验，涉及15,000多个决策，参与者包括金融专业人士和大学生，使用绿色、中性、棕色资产进行预算分配。
AI.findings: 1) 环境框架改变财务敏感性：对绿色资产的回报变化反应更强；2) 偏好不对称：对棕色资产的厌恶超过对绿色资产的偏好；3) 专业人士和学生都有环保倾向但动机不同：专业人士基于交易经验，学生基于亲社会态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了行为金融理论在可持续投资领域的应用，揭示了环境因素如何调节财务决策过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续投资产品设计和营销策略提供实证依据，帮助金融机构理解不同客户群体的环保投资动机。

title: Construction of a Coupling Relationship Network and Scenario Simulation for Sustainable Development in China's Arid Regions: A Case Study of Shihezi City​
affiliations: Hebei Agricultural University and Hebei Agricultural University

detail.title: Construction of a Coupling Relationship Network and Scenario Simulation for Sustainable Development in China's Arid Regions: A Case Study of Shihezi City​
detail.abstract: China's high-quality development strategy necessitates exploring pathways to achieve economic growth without ecological degradation. This study investigates how to avoid replicating the central and eastern regions' ecologically destructive development models while achieving economic sustainable development in western cities with fragile ecosystems. As water resources constitute the primary constraint on urban development in northwest China, optimising water-soil resource allocation under multi-factor influences proves critical for arid-region sustainability. Using Shihezi City as a case study, we analysed the coupling relationship between resource-environmental and socio-economic systems; simulated their interactions through a system dynamics (SD) model. Five future plans were designed based on attainment levels of social, economic, and ecological objectives, and a comprehensive benefit index was created based on these objective benefits. Key findings: Plan 4 demonstrated optimal sustainability, yielding 2035 benefits double those under current models; Exhibited balanced socio-ecological-economic outcomes; Imposed relatively minimal water constraints and relatively moderate cropland conversion and carbon emission reduction challenges. The varying benefits, costs, and implementation difficulties of different scenarios necessitate context-specific adaptive management.

AI.tldr: 本研究以石河子市为例，通过系统动力学模型分析资源环境与社会经济系统的耦合关系，设计了五种未来规划方案。研究发现方案4在可持续发展方面表现最佳，到2035年效益可达当前模式的两倍，实现了社会-生态-经济的平衡发展。
AI.research_question: 如何在生态系统脆弱的西部城市避免复制中东部地区生态破坏的发展模式，同时实现经济可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 中国高质量发展战略需要探索经济增长与生态保护并重的发展路径，特别是水资源作为西北城市发展主要约束条件下，优化水土资源配置对干旱地区可持续发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统动力学理论、耦合协调理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 采用系统动力学(SD)模型模拟资源环境与社会经济系统的相互作用，基于社会、经济和生态目标达成水平设计五种未来规划方案，并构建综合效益指数进行评估。
AI.findings: 方案4表现出最优的可持续性，2035年效益是当前模式的两倍；实现了社会-生态-经济的平衡结果；水资源约束相对最小，耕地转换和碳减排挑战相对适中。
AI.theory_contributions: 为干旱地区城市可持续发展提供了系统动力学建模方法，丰富了资源环境与社会经济系统耦合协调理论在实践中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西部生态脆弱城市提供了具体的可持续发展路径选择，方案4可作为政策制定的参考，帮助决策者在不同情景下进行适应性管理。

title: Effectiveness of the Community-Based Drug Rehabilitation Program among Reformed Persons Who Use Drugs: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Drug Testing Outcomes, Lived Experiences, and Policy Implications
affiliations: , , , World Citi Colleges - Quezon City - Graduate School Department and World Citi Colleges - Quezon City - Graduate School Department

detail.title: Effectiveness of the Community-Based Drug Rehabilitation Program among Reformed Persons Who Use Drugs: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Drug Testing Outcomes, Lived Experiences, and Policy Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Community-Based Drug Rehabilitation Program (CBDRP) has become a central strategy in the Philippines for addressing substance use, particularly among individuals who surrendered during the national anti-drug campaign. This literature review examines how CBDR programs are implemented, who participates in them, and the factors that influence their effectiveness and completion. Using a systematic literature review guided by the PRISMA framework, the research consolidates Philippine and international studies to examine the profile, lived experiences, and program outcomes of reformed persons who used drugs (RPWUDs) engaged in CBDRP. Findings show that participants often exhibit strong internal motivation and benefit from family and community encouragement. However, persistent challenges-such as stigma, limited resources, leadership and coordination gaps, and weak monitoring systems-continue to hinder program fidelity and sustainability. Although several studies report positive psychosocial outcomes and perceived behavioral improvements, few provide statistically validated data on drug test results or relapse prevention. Qualitative findings highlight that empathy, cultural sensitivity, and relationship-building between facilitators and clients are critical to program retention and long-term recovery. From a governance perspective, the success of CBDRP relies on strong inter-agency collaboration, competent local leadership, and continuous capacity-building among implementers. Strengthening data management systems, embedding evidence-based evaluation, and ensuring adequate and sustained funding are essential steps toward improving accountability, policy coherence, and the overall effectiveness of community-based rehabilitation in the country.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述分析了菲律宾社区戒毒康复计划的实施情况、参与者特征及影响因素。研究发现参与者有强烈内在动机且受益于家庭社区支持，但面临污名化、资源不足、领导协调问题等挑战。成功关键包括同理心、文化敏感性、关系建立，以及强有力的跨部门合作和持续资金支持。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾社区戒毒康复计划如何实施？谁参与其中？影响其有效性和完成率的因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 社区戒毒康复计划已成为菲律宾应对药物滥用的核心策略，特别是针对全国禁毒运动中自首的个体，需要系统评估其实施效果和影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PRISMA框架的系统文献综述方法，整合菲律宾和国际研究，考察戒毒康复者的特征、生活经验和项目成果。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA框架指导的系统文献综述，整合分析菲律宾和国际相关研究文献。
AI.findings: 参与者通常表现出强烈的内在动机，受益于家庭和社区鼓励；但面临污名化、资源有限、领导和协调差距、监测系统薄弱等持续挑战；定性研究强调同理心、文化敏感性和促进者与客户之间的关系建立对项目保留和长期康复至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 从治理角度阐明了社区戒毒康复计划成功的关键要素：强有力的跨部门协作、有能力的本地领导力、实施者的持续能力建设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出加强数据管理系统、嵌入循证评估、确保充足持续资金等具体措施，以改善问责制、政策连贯性和社区康复的整体有效性。

title: Quantum Information Technology and The Law
affiliations: and LML, University of Cambridge

detail.title: Quantum Information Technology and The Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This manuscript is a pre-print of a chapter forthcoming (open access) in Quantum Technology Governance: Law, Policy and Ethics in the Quantum Era, edited by Mateo Aboy, Marcelo Corrales Compagnucci & Timo Minssen (Springer, anticipated late 2025/early 2026).

detail.abstract: Quantum information technology (QIT) encompasses a collection of emerging innovations-quantum computing, quantum communication, and quantum sensing-that leverage unique properties of quantum systems, such as entanglement, superposition, and quantization, in order to process information in ways that are either classically impossible or infeasible. While QIT remains in relative infancy, its potential for unprecedented computational speedups, security of communication, and ultra-precise measurement foreshadows its impacts and risks across economic, strategic, and societal domains. We situate QIT within both its historical and technological context, focusing on the question of what is sui generis or unique about QIT with respect to both technical detail and governance imperatives. We identify how the unique ontological properties of quantum systems may raise novel legal conceptual dilemmas and propose a governance-stack model that aligns potential regulatory instruments with specific layers of the QIT technical stack, enabling precise risk assessment and stakeholder-focused regulation. By adopting an information-theoretic lens, we analyze how QIT's novel affordances-ranging from decryption of classical encryption to ultra-precise sensing-may potentially impact legal domains. Our contribution aims to lay a foundation for understanding QIT's legal implications, offering a framework to navigate its opportunities and risks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了量子信息技术（QIT）的独特属性及其法律影响，提出了治理堆栈模型来应对量子技术带来的新挑战。
AI.research_question: 量子信息技术相对于技术细节和治理需求而言，其独特性是什么？
AI.motivation: 量子信息技术具有前所未有的计算加速、通信安全和超精确测量潜力，但其独特的量子系统属性可能引发新的法律概念困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论视角、治理堆栈模型、量子系统本体论属性
AI.method: 历史和技术背景分析、信息论透镜分析、治理堆栈模型构建
AI.findings: 量子技术的独特属性（如纠缠、叠加、量子化）需要与QIT技术堆栈各层面对应的监管工具，量子技术的新功能（如经典加密解密、超精确传感）将对法律领域产生深远影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了量子信息技术治理堆栈模型，为理解QIT的法律影响奠定了基础框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了精确风险评估和利益相关者导向监管的框架，帮助应对量子技术带来的机遇和风险。

title: Technological Start-Ups and the Market Viability of Innovation in Nigeria’s Industrial Development

detail.title: Technological Start-Ups and the Market Viability of Innovation in Nigeria’s Industrial Development
detail.abstract:
This paper explores the role of technological start-ups in advancing Nigeria’s industrial development by examining the market viability of innovation across key sectors. Drawing on evidence from fintech, agritech, healthtech, logistics, e-commerce, and clean energy, the study highlights how homegrown innovations are reshaping traditional industries and addressing persistent national challenges. The paper shows that Nigeria’s digital economy contributes between 16–18% of GDP, with projections to reach 21%, underscoring the transformative power of tech-driven solutions. Yet, structural barriers such as unreliable power, inadequate infrastructure, limited early-stage funding, policy inconsistencies, and talent shortages continue to restrict the scale and sustainability of impact.

The paper argues that unlocking the potential of Nigeria’s innovation ecosystem requires deliberate interventions, including: (i) establishing innovation-focused funding mechanisms beyond fintech, (ii) strengthening public–private partnerships to improve power and broadband infrastructure, (iii) aligning STEM education with industrial needs, and (iv) creating predictable regulatory and intellectual property frameworks. These strategic measures are essential for bridging the gap between innovative solutions and industrial transformation. The paper concludes that Nigeria’s industrial future depends not on chance but on intentional policies and investments that enable start-ups to thrive as catalysts of sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了尼日利亚科技初创企业在推动工业发展中的作用，分析了各关键领域创新的市场可行性。研究发现数字经济占GDP的16-18%，预计将达21%，但基础设施不足、资金限制、政策不稳定和人才短缺等结构性障碍制约了影响的规模和可持续性。
AI.research_question: 科技初创企业如何通过创新推动尼日利亚的工业发展？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚面临工业发展挑战，而本土科技创新正在重塑传统产业并解决国家长期问题，需要系统评估其潜力和障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新生态系统理论、产业转型理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 基于金融科技、农业科技、健康科技、物流、电子商务和清洁能源等关键领域的实证证据分析
AI.findings: 1. 数字经济贡献GDP的16-18%，预计达21%；2. 本土创新正在重塑传统产业；3. 结构性障碍包括电力不可靠、基础设施不足、早期资金有限、政策不稳定和人才短缺
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家创新生态系统与工业转型关系的理解，提出了科技初创企业作为可持续发展催化剂的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了四项战略干预措施：建立创新导向的资金机制、加强公私合作改善基础设施、STEM教育与产业需求对接、建立可预测的监管和知识产权框架

title: Ethiopia's First Oil Refinery A Blueprint for African Industrial Collaboration and Energy Sovereignty

detail.title: Ethiopia's First Oil Refinery A Blueprint for African Industrial Collaboration and Energy Sovereignty
detail.abstract: In 2025, Ethiopia broke ground on its first oil refinery-a $2.5 billion strategic project with an annual production capacity of 3.5 million tons of refined fuel. Implemented in two phases, the first stage is projected for completion within 24 months. This paper explores the economic and strategic significance of Ethiopia's refinery as a case study in African industrial resurgence, examining its financing model, local and regional economic impact, and how it offers a replicable blueprint for other African nations.

AI.tldr: 埃塞俄比亚启动首个25亿美元炼油厂项目，分两期建设，首期24个月完成，年产能350万吨。本文探讨该项目作为非洲工业复兴案例的经济和战略意义，分析融资模式、本地和区域经济影响，以及为其他非洲国家提供的可复制蓝图。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚首个炼油厂项目如何体现非洲工业复兴的经济和战略意义？
AI.motivation: 埃塞俄比亚投资25亿美元建设首个炼油厂，这是非洲能源基础设施发展的重要里程碑，为研究非洲工业复兴提供了典型案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工业发展理论、能源安全理论和区域经济发展理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析埃塞俄比亚炼油厂项目的具体实施情况。
AI.findings: 该项目采用分阶段实施策略，首期24个月完成，年产能350万吨，具有显著的经济和战略价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非洲工业复兴理论提供了实证支持，丰富了能源基础设施发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他非洲国家提供了可复制的炼油厂建设蓝图，包括融资模式、实施策略和经济影响评估。

title: What Hinders Structural Reforms?
affiliations: University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS)

detail.title: What Hinders Structural Reforms?
detail.abstract: This paper studies the effect of political costs on implementing structural reforms in a macroeconomic political economy model with heterogeneous agents. I apply the model to consider product market deregulation as a reform measure. The policy creates divergent preferences over regulation levels among agents with different employment statuses. The deviation of the implemented regulation level from agents' preferences determines the magnitude of political cost they impose on the government. This political cost forces the government to implement an inefficiently high regulation level. The model predicts that the extent of the deregulation in the subsequent period is negatively related to the current regulation level. By mitigating the political costs, a lower proportion of liquidity-constrained workers and a lower prevalence of fixed-term labour contracts reduce market regulation levels. Effective communication strategies can help deregulation as well. Finally, the model offers insights into cross-country differences in product market regulation across selected European countries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究政治成本对结构性改革实施的影响，通过异质代理人宏观经济政治经济模型分析产品市场放松管制。研究发现政治成本导致政府实施低效率的高监管水平，放松管制程度与当前监管水平负相关。降低流动性约束工人比例和固定期限劳动合同普及度可减少市场监管水平，有效沟通策略也有助于放松管制。
AI.research_question: 政治成本如何影响结构性改革的实施？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么政府会实施低效率的高监管水平，以及什么因素影响产品市场放松管制的程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质代理人宏观经济政治经济模型，考虑不同就业状况代理人的偏好差异。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，应用产品市场放松管制作为改革措施。
AI.findings: 政治成本迫使政府实施低效率的高监管水平；放松管制程度与当前监管水平负相关；降低流动性约束工人比例和固定期限劳动合同普及度可减少市场监管水平；有效沟通策略有助于放松管制。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了政治成本影响结构性改革的理论框架，解释了监管水平偏离代理人偏好的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了降低政治成本、促进放松管制的策略建议，包括劳动力市场改革和沟通策略。

title: Training Data on Trial: AI's First Fair Use Test
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Training Data on Trial: AI's First Fair Use Test

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial interests or biases associated with the materials in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: I received no financial compensation associated with this research

detail.abstract:
This article analyzes how U.S. courts have begun applying the fair-use doctrine to large-scale artificial-intelligence training. In 2025, three federal district courts issued the first comprehensive opinions on this question:
(1) Thomson Reuters Enters. Ctr. GmbH v. Ross Intelligence Inc. (D. Del. 2025),
(2) Bartz v. Anthropic PBC (N.D. Cal. 2025), and
(3) Kadrey v. Meta Platforms Inc. (N.D. Cal. 2025).
The opinions collectively test whether copying copyrighted works to train language models constitutes a “transformative” use under 17 U.S.C. § 107. Ross Intelligence found infringement where AI training replicated a commercial product’s market function. Bartz and Kadrey instead deemed model training transformative, intermediate, and non-substitutive, emphasizing the absence of empirical market harm. Across all three cases, courts treat transformation as function-specific, intermediate
copying as permissible when non-expressive, market harm as requiring proof, and the creative nature of works as of diminished weight in analytical contexts. Together, these decisions define an emerging fair-use boundary for AI: training that learns from expression without substituting for it.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国法院如何开始将合理使用原则应用于大规模人工智能训练。2025年三个联邦地方法院的判决确立了AI训练合理使用的边界：当AI学习表达内容但不替代原作品市场功能时，构成合理使用。
AI.research_question: 美国法院如何将合理使用原则应用于大规模人工智能训练？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展，如何平衡版权保护与AI训练需求成为重要法律问题，需要分析法院的最新判例来明确法律边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国版权法第107条合理使用原则，特别是"转化性使用"概念。
AI.method: 案例分析三个2025年联邦地方法院判例：Thomson Reuters v. Ross Intelligence、Bartz v. Anthropic、Kadrey v. Meta Platforms。
AI.findings: 法院认为AI模型训练具有转化性、中间性和非替代性特征，强调需要实证证明市场损害，作品创造性在分析中权重降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了AI训练合理使用的法律边界，发展了转化性使用的具体标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI公司提供了法律指导，帮助平衡技术创新与版权保护。

title: Factors Forming a Company's Strategy in Two-Sided Markets
affiliations: Moscow State University of International Relations (MGIMO University)

detail.title: Factors Forming a Company's Strategy in Two-Sided Markets
detail.abstract: The study of two-sided externalities and two-sided markets began relatively recently. Although the term "two-sided markets" was first used in 1962, the focus has shifted to analyzing the economics of platform technologies. Typically, a two-sided market is viewed as a market where a firm acts as a platform, selling a product to two groups of consumers. The demand of one group of consumers influences the demand of the other group, and vice versa. Essentially, two-sided and multi-sided markets are network markets that involve two or more groups of consumers, with mutual network effects. These mutual network effects are a form of spillover effects, where consumers in one group respond to changes in the number of consumers in another group. Examples of such markets include e-commerce platforms, digital platforms, media businesses, etc. Such markets demonstrate high growth dynamics. In Russia, the online retail market grew by approximately 37-41% in 2024, the digital ecosystem subscription market grew by 74.5%, and the consumption of cloud services, including IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS segments, reached 392 billion rubles in Russia. (Data from the Bank of Russia). Two-sided and multi-sided markets have specific features that a company operating or planning to operate in such a market must take into account. First, it is a matter of pricing structure: the company needs to identify the segment of consumers who will create network externalities and the group that will generate profits for the company. There are business models that rely on users (operating system platforms for personal computers and portable devices) and business models that rely on developers (video game platforms). Moreover, when setting prices, it is important to consider not only the strength of mutual network externalities, but also the price elasticity of demand, costs, consumers' willingness to pay, etc. Secondly, the company should take into account the potential negative network effects that may arise due to competition among network members. Finally, platform competition may occur, where multiple competing platforms exist. Thus, a company operating in a two-sided market must take into account not only the traditional factors that are important for developing a strategy, but also a number of new circumstances that affect the market and the activities of its players.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了双边和多边市场的特征，包括网络效应、定价结构、竞争动态等，并基于俄罗斯市场数据探讨了企业在这些市场中运营的战略考量。
AI.research_question: 企业在双边和多边市场中需要考虑哪些特殊因素来制定有效的商业战略？
AI.motivation: 双边和多边市场具有快速增长的特点，如俄罗斯在线零售市场在2024年增长37-41%，数字生态系统订阅市场增长74.5%，企业需要理解这些市场的独特特征以制定有效战略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边市场理论、网络外部性理论、平台经济学
AI.method: 理论分析结合俄罗斯市场实证数据
AI.findings: 1. 定价结构需要考虑网络外部性创造者和利润贡献者；2. 存在基于用户和基于开发者的不同商业模式；3. 需要考虑负面网络效应和平台竞争；4. 传统战略因素外还需考虑新的市场特征
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对双边市场定价结构和竞争动态的理解，扩展了平台经济学在快速增长市场中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业进入或运营双边市场提供了具体的战略指导，包括定价策略制定、商业模式选择和竞争应对

title: Prenatal exposure to pollution, subsequent parental behaviour and educational achievement
affiliations: University of Groningen, University of Groningen and University of Oxford

detail.title: Prenatal exposure to pollution, subsequent parental behaviour and educational achievement
detail.abstract: Prenatal exposure to air pollution has been shown to have adverse effects on health and educational achievement. The size of these effects may depend on parental involvement in the child’s development. Using data from Germany, we investigate such interaction effects on entry into the academic secondary-school track (Gymnasium) and on school grades. To deal with potential endogeneity of pollution exposure, we leverage variations in the height of the planetary boundary layer, an exogenous atmospheric variable strongly predicting pollution levels. We find that higher in-utero pollution exposure decreases the likelihood of entering the academic track, especially among low-SES children. Importantly, high maternal involvement in engaging activities effectively mitigates the adverse effects of pollution, while a high frequency of passive, screen-based activities with the child does not moderate pollution effects.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在子宫内暴露于空气污染会降低儿童进入学术轨道的可能性，特别是对低社会经济地位儿童影响更大。高水平的母亲参与互动活动能有效缓解污染的不利影响，而频繁的被动屏幕活动则无此效果。
AI.research_question: 产前空气污染暴露如何影响儿童教育成就？父母的参与行为是否调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明产前空气污染对健康和学业成就有不利影响，但这些影响的大小可能取决于父母在儿童发展中的参与程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境流行病学和发展心理学的交叉框架，结合社会经济地位和父母参与的理论。
AI.method: 使用德国数据，利用行星边界层高度的外生变化作为污染暴露的工具变量，分析对学术轨道入学和学业成绩的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 产前污染暴露降低进入学术轨道的可能性，尤其对低SES儿童影响显著；2) 高水平的母亲互动参与能有效缓解污染的不利影响；3) 被动的屏幕活动无法调节污染效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统检验了父母参与在空气污染与教育成就关系中的调节作用，揭示了不同类型的父母参与行为具有不同的保护效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体建议：应特别关注低SES家庭的污染防护，并鼓励积极的亲子互动活动而非被动屏幕时间。

title: On the Nature of the Firm: A Discussion on the Differences Between Chinese and American Firm
affiliations: Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business

detail.title: On the Nature of the Firm: A Discussion on the Differences Between Chinese and American Firm
detail.abstract: We first review the research topic of the 'nature of the firm' from an interdisciplinary perspective. Subsequently, we examine how the legal, business, organizational, and financial dimensions collectively shape the boundaries and practices of a firm from the perspectives of various stakeholders, including entrepreneurs, managers, and investors, and compare the differences between China and the United States in these aspects. The study demonstrates that cultural differences have a profound influence on corporate behavior, emphasizing the importance of cross-dimensional analysis in understanding corporate behavior and enhancing firm competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文从跨学科视角回顾了'企业本质'研究主题，分析了法律、商业、组织和财务维度如何共同塑造企业边界和实践，比较了中美两国在这些方面的差异，发现文化差异对企业行为有深远影响。
AI.research_question: 法律、商业、组织和财务维度如何共同塑造企业边界和实践？中美两国在这些方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 从跨学科视角深入理解企业本质，分析不同维度对企业行为的影响，以及文化差异在塑造企业实践中的重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业本质理论、利益相关者理论、跨文化管理理论

AI.findings: 文化差异对企业行为有深远影响，中美两国在企业边界和实践方面存在显著差异，跨维度分析对理解企业行为和提升竞争力至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了企业本质研究的跨学科分析框架，深化了对文化因素在企业边界形成中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业家、管理者和投资者提供了跨文化背景下企业实践的指导，有助于提升企业在全球化环境中的竞争力。

title: Human Rights, the Climate Emergency, and the Financial System
affiliations: ,  and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Human Rights, the Climate Emergency, and the Financial System

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Central Bank Legal Working Paper Series 2025/23
publicationDetails.journalName: European Central Bank Legal Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: On 9 April 2024, the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) delivered a landmark ruling in Verein KlimaSeniorinnen Schweiz and Others v. Switzerland. The ruling was handed down together with two further rulings in Duarte Agostinho and others v. Portugal and others, and in Carême v. France. The ruling marked the first time the ECtHR held that insufficient climate action by a state constitutes a violation of human rights under the European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR). While primarily having an impact on Switzerland as a defending State, the ruling is expected to indirectly affect the legal order of the European Union and its institutions. Moreover, the findings of the ECtHR have been reinforced by recent advisory opinions of other international courts and tribunals, in particular the opinion of the International Court of Justice, handed down on 23 July 2025. This paper first recalls the key facts and outcomes from each of the three ECtHR climate rulings and explores the key findings in greater detail. Second, the paper outlines the climate rulings of other international courts and tribunals. Thereafter, the paper explains the relevance of the KlimaSeniorinnen ruling for the Union and its institutions. First, as a matter of substance, the paper explains how the ruling carries lessons for the ambition and implementation of the climate policies of the Union and its Member States. Second, the paper goes on to explore the procedural avenues for litigants to bring an action before the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU), to challenge Union policies on the basis of the ECtHR’s ruling. The paper then outlines how the ruling may be relevant to the ECB, and for the national central banks (NCBs) and national competent authorities (NCAs) within the Eurosystem and Single Supervisory Mechanism. Finally, the paper explores how the ruling may be relevant to the financial sector, insofar as it increases the risk of litigation, and risks related to the process of adjustment towards a low-carbon economy (transition risk).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧洲人权法院在KlimaSeniorinnen案中的里程碑裁决，该裁决首次认定国家气候行动不足构成人权侵犯，并探讨了该裁决对欧盟及其机构的法律影响。
AI.research_question: 欧洲人权法院气候裁决对欧盟法律秩序和机构的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 2024年欧洲人权法院首次裁决国家气候行动不足违反人权，这一里程碑裁决对欧盟法律体系产生重要影响，需要系统分析其法律后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧洲人权公约的人权保护框架、欧盟法律秩序与国际法的互动关系、气候变化诉讼理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法和比较法研究，分析三个欧洲人权法院气候裁决案例及其他国际法庭咨询意见。
AI.findings: 欧洲人权法院裁决确立了国家气候不作为的人权责任；该裁决将间接影响欧盟法律秩序；为在欧盟法院挑战气候政策提供了程序途径；对欧洲央行和金融部门产生过渡风险影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了人权法在气候变化领域的适用，建立了气候不作为与人权侵犯的法律联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候诉讼提供了法律依据，指导欧盟及其成员国提升气候政策雄心，警示金融机构关注气候相关诉讼风险。

title: Assessing the impact of natural land on farmland value in Mediterranean EU countries
affiliations: Università degli Studi di Catania and Yale University - School of Forestry & Environmental Studies

detail.title: Assessing the impact of natural land on farmland value in Mediterranean EU countries
detail.abstract: There is limited empirical research on how natural land in the surrounding landscape affects farmland value. Drawing on a unique data set that combines farm-level information with land cover data within a 5 km radius of each farm, this study applies a hedonic approach to evaluate how natural land influences farmland values across five Euro-Mediterranean countries. We assess the effects of reallocating land between natural land types and between natural land and agriculture across all farms, as well as separately for crop farms and livestock farms. The results show that mixed forests, shrubland, and inland wetlands all provide positive externalities, whereas most other natural land types tend to reduce farmland value. These beneficial effects apply to crop farms, while the effect of natural land on livestock farms is generally negative. Overall, these results underscore the need for more targeted natural land management strategies that account for both land type and farming system.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用享乐方法评估自然土地对地中海五国农田价值的影响，发现混合森林、灌木丛和内陆湿地提供正外部性，而其他自然土地类型通常降低农田价值。这些有益效果主要适用于种植农场，而对畜牧农场的影响通常为负面。
AI.research_question: 自然土地如何影响农田价值？
AI.motivation: 关于周边景观中自然土地如何影响农田价值的实证研究有限
AI.theoretical_framework: 享乐定价方法
AI.method: 结合农场层面信息和每个农场5公里半径内土地覆盖数据的独特数据集，应用于五个地中海国家
AI.findings: 混合森林、灌木丛和内陆湿地提供正外部性，其他自然土地类型通常降低农田价值；对种植农场有益，对畜牧农场影响负面
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了自然土地对农田价值影响的实证证据，强调了土地类型和农业系统的差异
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要制定更针对性的自然土地管理策略，考虑土地类型和农业系统

title: The Value of Water Access Security in Agriculture
affiliations: Texas A&M University - College of Agriculture and Life Sciences, Texas A&M University, University of Georgia, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Texas A&M University

detail.title: The Value of Water Access Security in Agriculture
detail.abstract: Institutions are crucial for allocating natural resources. Surface water allocation in the western U.S. follows the prior appropriation doctrine, which distributes water based on the date when water was first appropriated for beneficial use. During scarcity, water is allocated by seniority, with holders of more junior rights losing access first. Curtailments of water access influence the profitability of irrigated production, especially in the arid West where most croplands depend on irrigation. The Ricardian theory of rent suggests a premium for senior water rights, as the net present value of long-term returns is higher due to more secure access. We estimate this premium using a hedonic pricing model and agricultural land transactions as proxies for water-rights values. Our dataset links roughly 25,000 sales across 37 Colorado counties with geocoded information on associated water rights. Results show that surface-water access increases land values by about $6,300 per acre, or 64 % relative to similar non-irrigated parcels. Furthermore, we estimate the premium for properties that are one year more senior in water rights to be about $49 per acre. Our results also indicate that properties with access to storage and supplementary groundwater rights sell, on average, for 16% and 14% more, respectively, compared to irrigated properties with only surface water access. These findings highlight the importance of water security in shaping agricultural land markets and offer insights into how policy measures, such as expanding water markets or investing in storage reservoirs, can potentially improve allocation and reduce vulnerability of irrigated agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过享乐定价模型估计了美国西部水权的价值，发现地表水使用权使土地价值增加约6,300美元/英亩，水权每早一年获得溢价约49美元/英亩，拥有水库储水和补充地下水权的土地分别溢价16%和14%。
AI.research_question: 水权优先权在农业土地市场中是否具有价值溢价？
AI.motivation: 美国西部采用优先占用原则分配水资源，在缺水时期按水权获得时间分配，理论上更早的水权应具有更高价值，但缺乏实证估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 李嘉图地租理论，认为水权优先权因其更安全的用水保障而具有长期回报溢价。
AI.method: 享乐定价模型，使用农业土地交易数据作为水权价值的代理变量，数据集包含科罗拉多州37个县的约25,000笔交易。
AI.findings: 地表水使用权使土地价值增加64%；水权每早一年溢价约49美元/英亩；拥有储水和地下水权的土地分别溢价16%和14%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为李嘉图地租理论在水权市场中的适用性提供了实证支持，证实了水权优先权的经济价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水权市场定价提供参考，表明扩大水市场和投资储水设施可改善水资源分配，降低灌溉农业的脆弱性。

title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Human Rights in Nigeria: Conflict or Consonance
affiliations: Lead City University

detail.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Human Rights in Nigeria: Conflict or Consonance
detail.abstract:
This work examines human rights in Nigeria, the meaning of Artificial Intelligence and its existence in Nigeria, whilst also examining its positive and negative influence on specifically highlighted fundamental rights recognized internationally and in the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. 

This work concludes by drawing a resolution on how the concept of artificial intelligence conflicts with some constitutionally-protected human rights in Nigeria but also how there is a future capable of accommodating a consonance between both, and this work dishes two fundamental recommendations to arrive at this desired consonance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在尼日利亚的发展及其对人权的影响，分析了AI与宪法保护人权的冲突，并提出了实现两者和谐共存的建议。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响尼日利亚宪法保护的基本人权？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在尼日利亚的发展，需要研究其对基本人权的潜在影响，包括正面和负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际人权法和尼日利亚宪法框架，分析人工智能与人权的关系。
AI.method: 理论分析，通过比较国际人权标准和尼日利亚宪法规定来评估AI的影响。
AI.findings: 人工智能与尼日利亚宪法保护的某些人权存在冲突，但存在实现和谐共存的可能。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了人工智能与人权关系的理论分析框架，特别关注发展中国家背景。

detail.title: Energy Productivity and Economic Growth Nexus: A Case Study of Pakistan from 1990-2018
detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between energy and economic growth in Pakistan from 1990 to 2018. Using Gross Domestic Product (GDP) as the dependent variable, the study examines the effects of gross fixed capital formation, labor productivity, energy balance, oil prices, and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in the energy sector as independent variables. The analytical framework employs the Auto Regressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) Model, while the stability of variables is assessed through CUSUM and CUSUM Square tests. Key findings reveal that labor force participation in the energy sector and rising oil prices have a sustained negative impact on economic growth. Conversely, gross fixed capital formation positively influences GDP both in the short and long term. Interestingly, FDI in the energy sector shows a negative effect on GDP in the short term but a positive effect in the long term. The study emphasizes the need for a comprehensive transformation of Pakistan's energy sector. It recommends a strategic shift from hydrocarbon-based energy to hydropower to stabilize oil prices and achieve significant, sustainable production increases in the long term. These findings provide critical insights into Pakistan's energy economic relationship, offering valuable guidance for policymakers, scholars, and industry stakeholders.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Taxation of Trusts, Foundations and Similar Arrangements in a Global Setting

detail.abstract:
Recent proposals for a global wealth tax have revitalized long-standing debates about how to design such taxes. The discussion is particularly difficult because these are taxes that have been abandoned by most of our neighboring countries with high taxation systems (OECD members, EU countries). This means that there are not many useful examples today. In addition, a striking aspect of the proposals is that the element of legal design is often absent. Consequently, the central aspect of any wealth tax, which is defining wealth for legal purposes and measuring its amount, does not appear among the core elements of the proposals.

This chapter examines some of the issues that arise when trying to design a comprehensive wealth tax which may be applied to different legal structures. A key element lies in the different conceptions of property that are evident in specific legal structures, such as trusts and similar arrangements, and the challenge that this poses for this type of taxes. In particular, the focus will be on Trust structures, which are notably difficult to compare across countries, or even within one jurisdiction, as they often respond to very different logics and interests.

The chapter will first (II) tackle the current debate on wealth taxation and assess some of the main proposals. The proposals are very different, and it does not help that wealth taxes have become a rare breed, which in turn encourages creativity, not always helpful for the sake of comparisons, in the different proposed taxes. It will then (III) examine the challenges of subjecting trust structures to a net wealth tax. Trusts, often used as vehicles for managing and “protecting” family wealth, present unique difficulties in determining ownership and tax liability, as well as international recognition issues. In practice, the various and varying purposes of trusts, from charitable to discretionary inter alia, will often complicate their treatment under a wealth tax regime. Finally, (IV) the chapter explores examples of existing wealth taxes in different jurisdictions and discuss the constitutional and practical challenges that have arisen.

Although this chapter does not focus on any specific country, particular attention will be paid to the Spanish case, as it does remain one of the few jurisdictions that has managed to not fully eliminate a net wealth tax, which has undergone a particular reform in recent times. This makes it a test bed, not necessarily a positive one, for the kind of problems posed by these taxes and by ownership unbundling structures such as trusts.

title: Beliefs, Information Trust, and Air Pollution

detail.title: Beliefs, Information Trust, and Air Pollution
detail.abstract: This paper examines how the quality of disclosures shapes public trust in official data. Using daily emission records from waste-to-energy plants in China (2020-2022) and housing data from 92 cities, I estimate pollution beliefs through a residential sorting model. Households perceive higher and more uncertain emissions when records are flawed, despite technical explanations of the flaws. There is limited evidence of manipulation by plants, suggesting fundamental distrust. The estimated household's annual willingness to pay for a 1% improvement in information quality is $1.23. The results show that low-quality disclosure discounts the value of information and erodes information trust.

AI.tldr: 本文研究信息披露质量如何影响公众对官方数据的信任。基于中国垃圾焚烧发电厂排放记录和住房数据，研究发现信息披露缺陷会降低公众信任，即使有技术解释也无法消除这种影响。家庭愿意为信息质量提升支付费用，表明低质量披露会削弱信息价值。

title: Measuring Acquisition-led Growth as a Rising Corporate Strategy
affiliations: University of Geneva

detail.title: Measuring Acquisition-led Growth as a Rising Corporate Strategy
detail.abstract: This paper argues that mergers and acquisitions (M&A) have become a primary corporate growth strategy for U.S. non-financial corporations and should be treated as investment from the firm's perspective. Using Compustat firm-level data (1980-2019), I document a compositional shift from productive assets toward goodwill and other intangibles, with goodwill surpassing 15% of total assets among large acquirers. When total investment is measured as capital expenditures plus acquisition outlays in real terms, the common time-series component shows no secular decline. Acquisition activity is highly concentrated: the top decile accounts for over 90% of spending. These "high acquirers" grow assets 14-16 percentage points faster and sales 5-9 points faster than other firms; the growth premium vanishes when firms are grouped by accumulated intangibles (excluding goodwill), indicating that the advantage reflects acquisition intensity rather than intangible stocks. Post-2000, acquisition intensity becomes a stronger predictor than capital expenditures of entering the top decile by assets, sales, and sales-weighted markups. Markups and profit shares concentrate at the top: the profit share of the top decile of acquirers rises from 24% in the 1980s to 51% by 2008-2020. I propose a framework that links acquisition-led growth to four stylized facts-measured investment stagnation, rising concentration, higher markups, and profit concentration-and discuss implications for measurement and merger policy.

AI.tldr: 本文认为并购已成为美国非金融企业的主要增长战略，应被视为企业投资。研究发现投资构成从生产性资产转向商誉等无形资产，并购活动高度集中，前10%收购者增长更快且利润份额显著上升。

detail.title: Economic Policy Uncertainty and Accounting Reporting Complexity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming, Journal of Accounting, Auditing and Finance

detail.abstract: We posit that accounting reporting complexity includes two components-monetary reporting complexity (MRC) and textual reporting complexity (TRC). It is generally challenging to disentangle these components because they tend to increase with real business activities. Economic policy uncertainty (EPU) provides an ideal setting to overcome this challenge. Greater EPU reduces real business activities, suggesting a reduction in MRC. However, TRC can increase or decrease depending on disclosure incentives. Using monetary and textual eXtensible Business Reporting Language (XBRL) tags to measure MRC and TRC, respectively, we find that high EPU reduces MRC but increases TRC. These findings survive a series of robustness checks. Additional analyses show that [1] these relationships hold for all ten policy categories; [2] the reduction in five hard-to-reverse business activities drives the reduction in MRC; [3] the decrease in MRC drives the increase in TRC; [4] the simultaneous changes in MRC and TRC help reduce the increase in information asymmetry due to high EPU; and [5] these relationships are stronger for firms relying more on the government for their operations and weaker for firms with high political risk or proprietary risk. Collectively, these results suggest that, when facing greater uncertainty about future economic policies, firms tend to delay real economic activities and justify this reduction using textual disclosure. Our study makes several contributions to research on economic policy uncertainty and accounting reporting complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现经济政策不确定性(EPU)会降低货币报告复杂性(MRC)但增加文本报告复杂性(TRC)，企业通过延迟实际经济活动并用文本披露来合理化这种减少，从而缓解信息不对称问题。
AI.research_question: 经济政策不确定性如何影响会计报告复杂性的两个组成部分——货币报告复杂性和文本报告复杂性？

AI.theoretical_framework: 会计报告复杂性理论、经济政策不确定性理论、信息披露激励理论
AI.method: 使用货币和文本XBRL标签分别测量MRC和TRC，利用经济政策不确定性作为准自然实验
AI.findings: 高EPU会降低MRC但增加TRC；这种关系在所有十个政策类别中都成立；难以逆转的业务活动减少驱动MRC降低；MRC减少驱动TRC增加；MRC和TRC的同步变化有助于减少高EPU导致的信息不对称增加
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将会计报告复杂性分解为货币和文本两个维度进行研究，揭示了EPU对两者的差异化影响机制

title: Race, Violence, and the Effectiveness of Protest
affiliations: University of Rochester - Department of Political Science, Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Hebrew University, Tel Aviv University, Ben Gurion University of the Negev,  Columbia University, Department of Political Science, Students , Harvard University - Havard Keneddy School and Harvard University - Havard Keneddy School

detail.title: Race, Violence, and the Effectiveness of Protest
detail.abstract: Protests constitute a primary way that members of the public express their preferences and seek to change public policy. Focusing on policy protests in the United States, we develop hypotheses about the impact of protesters’ race (Black or white) and violent disruptive tactics on the effectiveness of protests. We test our predictions with parallel experiments that expose citizens, individuals affiliated with civic organizations, and public officials to protest scenarios. We find that violent protests generate disapproval but also, perhaps surprisingly, policy responsiveness.  These relationships hold regardless of the race of the protesters. When it comes to nonviolent protests, however, race fundamentally matters and in countervailing ways. Black nonviolent protesters receive less approval than white nonviolent protesters, but they also are the only ones to generate policy responsiveness. These findings suggest that assertions about the relative impact of violent or nonviolent protests need to consider the identity of the protesters given that not all nonviolent protests are treated equally.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现暴力抗议虽然引发不赞成但能带来政策响应，且这种效果不受抗议者种族影响。而非暴力抗议中，黑人抗议者获得较少支持但却是唯一能引发政策响应的群体，表明抗议效果需考虑抗议者身份。

AI.motivation: 抗议是公众表达偏好和寻求改变公共政策的主要方式，需要了解不同抗议策略和抗议者身份如何影响政策响应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于抗议政治理论和种族政治理论，探讨抗议策略（暴力/非暴力）与抗议者种族对政策响应性的交互影响。

AI.findings: 1）暴力抗议引发不赞成但产生政策响应，且不受种族影响；2）非暴力抗议中，黑人抗议者获得较少支持但却是唯一能引发政策响应的群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于非暴力抗议普遍有效的假设，强调抗议者身份在抗议效果中的关键作用，为抗议政治理论提供种族视角。

detail.title: Guidance on the Environmental Conditions of Detention

publicationDetails.detailsText: Edinburgh School of Law Research Paper No. 2025.27
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Edinburgh School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
‘Environmental conditions’ refer in particular to the sensory environment in places of detention. Four aspects are discussed here: sound, light, temperature and air. ‘Detention’ means any situation in which people are deprived of their liberty. These environmental conditions of detention cover prisons, remand centres, and secure accommodation for children. They are also relevant for other sites of detention, such as asylum reception centres, hospitals and care homes when detention is mandated. This brief offers clarity on how existing rules of detention apply and explains why the environmental conditions of detention warrant further consideration.

Often, places of detention have been constructed without due consideration of the importance of our immediate environment, and this potential for harm. The combined impact of poor environmental conditions may in fact constitute cruel, inhuman and degrading treatment as defined in international law. In addition, manipulation of environmental and sensory conditions has often been used intentionally as a method of torture. Poor environmental conditions can also exacerbate the impact of other methods of torture and ill-treatment.

detail.abstract: The high level of inequality of income and wealth, and outcome and opportunity, across individuals, groups, and nations, is widely and credibly regarded as among the most fundamental problems facing humanity. Yet public outrage about inequality remains surprisingly limited, even among those who are disadvantaged by it, and democracies often elect and re-elect politicians who deliver policies that exacerbate rather than reduce inequality. We argue that this disconnect arises from basic features of human social cognition which evolved for interpersonal interactions in small groups rather than for navigating the vast political, economic, and technological systems that shape contemporary life. The key features of social cognition are: (i) a focus on local notions of equality and equity between socially connected individuals, rather than across society at large; (ii) group identification, which directs attention to inequality between groups rather than ‘pure’ inequality across the broader population; and (iii) what we call an i-frame bias—a tendency to explain social outcomes, including inequality, as the product of individual behaviors, taking the system within which those individuals operate as a given. We extend our analysis to examine how the very wealthy exploit these features of social cognition to shape the political and policy landscape, and propose a “political psychology” of inequality which is analogous to the subfield of political economy in economics.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了为什么公众对收入财富不平等的愤怒有限，认为这是由于人类社会认知的三大特征：关注局部平等、群体认同和个体框架偏见，这些特征被富裕阶层利用来影响政策。

title: An Ecological-Economic Approach to Air Pollution Regulation in New Delhi, India
affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology

detail.title: An Ecological-Economic Approach to Air Pollution Regulation in New Delhi, India
detail.abstract: In this paper, we develop a new way of looking at the New Delhi, India, air pollution regulation problem that pays attention to both the ecological and the economic aspects of this problem. We first construct a theoretical model of air quality in New Delhi. We then show how the dynamic and stochastic properties of air quality in New Delhi can be used to derive two criterion functions for a regulator that are ecologically meaningful. Finally, using these two criteria, we discuss a probabilistic approach to the determination of the optimal length of time during which air quality regulations are in place. In our approach, the objective of the regulator is to maintain the ecological and economic viability of air quality in New Delhi in the long-run.

AI.method: 构建理论模型，利用空气质量的动态随机特性推导标准函数，采用概率方法确定管制时长
AI.findings: 开发了两个生态意义的标准函数，提出了基于概率的管制时长优化方法
AI.theory_contributions: 为空气污染管制提供了同时整合生态和经济维度的新理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为新德里空气质量管制提供了具体的决策工具和方法论

title: Coordinating Inventory and Fulfillment (and Pricing) Decisions in E-Commerce Supply Chains
affiliations: Queen's University - Smith School of Business, University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business, University of Colorado at Boulder, Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Ahmedabad and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)

detail.title: Coordinating Inventory and Fulfillment (and Pricing) Decisions in E-Commerce Supply Chains
detail.abstract: We study the management of large-scale e-commerce retail networks with multiple distribution centers (DCs) and fulfillment centers (FCs). Each FC is associated with a local demand area (its closest market) but may also be used to fulfill demand from other areas. Each DC is endowed with a fixed initial inventory and will not be replenished throughout the finite selling horizon. In each period, the retailer makes two types of decisions: (i) how much inventory to move from DCs to FCs, and (ii) how to satisfy the realized demand. Demand can be satisfied in four possible ways: from FC inventory, from DC inventory, through an outside option, or by backlogging it to the next period. We first analyze this joint inventory–fulfillment problem, which is computationally intractable due to the curse of dimensionality, and develop a Lagrangian-relaxation-based heuristic. The relaxation admits a tractable structure: a base-stock replenishment rule coupled with a myopic fulfillment policy. Leveraging this structure, we propose the \emph{Lagrangian Base-Stock with Fulfillment} (LBSF) policy and show that it is asymptotically near-optimal as the horizon grows. Numerical experiments on both synthetic data and real-world data from Flipkart, a major e-commerce retailer, demonstrate that LBSF converges rapidly and substantially outperforms widely used benchmark heuristics. We then extend the framework to incorporate dynamic pricing decisions, which have become increasingly relevant in online retail. In this setting, the relaxation yields a joint base-stock and list-price structure, leading to the \emph{Lagrangian Base-Stock List-Price with Fulfillment} (LBSLPF) policy. We prove that LBSLPF achieves the same asymptotic near-optimality guarantee as LBSF.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有多个配送中心和履约中心的大规模电商零售网络管理问题，开发了基于拉格朗日松弛的启发式算法LBSF和LBSLPF，证明其在长销售周期下渐近接近最优，并在Flipkart真实数据上验证了性能优势。
AI.research_question: 如何有效管理具有多个配送中心和履约中心的大规模电商零售网络中的联合库存-履约决策问题？
AI.motivation: 大规模电商零售网络面临复杂的库存分配和需求满足决策，传统方法因维度灾难而计算不可行，需要开发高效且接近最优的启发式算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于拉格朗日松弛理论，结合基础库存策略和近视履约策略，构建可处理的优化结构。
AI.method: 开发拉格朗日基础库存履约策略(LBSF)和拉格朗日基础库存定价履约策略(LBSLPF)，使用合成数据和Flipkart真实数据进行数值实验验证。
AI.findings: LBSF和LBSLPF策略在长销售周期下渐近接近最优，收敛速度快，显著优于广泛使用的基准启发式算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于拉格朗日松弛的联合库存-履约决策框架，证明了策略的渐近最优性保证，扩展了动态定价下的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商零售商提供了可实施的库存管理和需求满足策略，在真实数据上验证了性能优势，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: FCPA Update: DOJ Encourages US Companies to Report Corrupt Foreign Competitors
affiliations: University of Colorado School of Law, White & Case LLP, White & Case LLP, White & Case LLP and White & Case LLP

detail.title: FCPA Update: DOJ Encourages US Companies to Report Corrupt Foreign Competitors
detail.abstract:
Although most reporting on the DOJ's latest Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) guidelines has emphasized the anticipated reduction in overall anti-corruption enforcement, an equally important, but less noted, aspect has emerged: the DOJ’s new laser-like focus on protecting US businesses harmed by competitors – particularly foreign ones – unfairly using bribery to secure business advantages.

·       For US-based companies, this amounts to a formal invitation to level the competitive playing field by becoming whistleblowers, proactively investigating alleged competitor misconduct and making a report to the DOJ.

·       For non-US companies with a US jurisdictional nexus, on the other hand, the DOJ guidelines signal a materially enhanced risk of becoming an enforcement target.

AI.tldr: 美国司法部最新FCPA指南不仅预期减少反腐败执法，更强调保护美国企业免受外国竞争者通过贿赂获取不公平竞争优势。美国企业被鼓励成为举报者，而非美国企业面临更高的执法风险。
AI.research_question: 美国司法部最新FCPA指南如何影响美国企业和非美国企业的竞争环境和执法风险？
AI.motivation: 现有报道主要关注FCPA执法总体减少，但忽视了指南对美国企业保护和对非美国企业风险增强的重要方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反腐败执法理论、竞争公平性理论、举报者激励机制理论
AI.method: 政策文本分析、执法指南解读、案例比较分析
AI.findings: 1) 美国企业被正式邀请成为举报者，主动调查竞争对手不当行为；2) 非美国企业面临显著增强的执法风险；3) 指南旨在通过保护美国企业来平衡竞争环境
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了FCPA执法理论，强调保护国内企业免受不公平国际竞争的理论维度
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国企业提供明确的举报路径，为非美国企业警示增强的合规要求，为企业制定反腐败策略提供实践指导

reference: Utrecht Journal of International and European Law, volume 40, issue 1, 2025[10.5334/ujiel.644]
title: Copyright Denied for Generative AI: Remarks on Thaler v Perlmutter

detail.title: Copyright Denied for Generative AI: Remarks on Thaler v Perlmutter

publicationDetails.detailsText: Utrecht Journal of International and European Law, volume 40, issue 1, 2025[10.5334/ujiel.644]

detail.abstract: In Thaler v Perlmutter, the United States District Court for the District of Columbia had to decide whether an artwork allegedly produced autonomously by an artificial intelligence ('AI') system was copyright subject matter. The Court held that a work must be a result of human authorship to receive copyright protection and therefore upheld the decision of the United States Copyright Office denying the registration of copyright for a piece of AI-generated visual art. The Court reached this conclusion considering the meaning of 'author' in the Copyright Act of 1976, the Copyright Clause in the United States Constitution, and prior judicial decisions dealing with non-human authorship. The Court's constitutional analysis of the issue implies that the Copyright Act cannot be interpreted to protect AI-generated works and may suggest that Congress is constitutionally precluded from amending it to protect such works. This outcome would be inconsistent with the power of Congress under the Copyright Clause in the United States Constitution. Furthermore, despite the strong role of the economic incentive theory in United States copyright law, its use by the Court against the protection of AI-generated works overlooks the fact that the connection between this theory and human authorship is not exclusive.

AI.tldr: 美国法院在Thaler v Perlmutter案中裁定，AI生成的作品因缺乏人类作者身份而无法获得版权保护，这一决定可能限制了国会在宪法框架下修改版权法的权力。
AI.research_question: AI生成的作品是否应受版权保护？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的发展，AI生成作品的法律地位问题日益突出，需要明确其版权保护资格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于1976年版权法、美国宪法版权条款、先例判决以及经济激励理论。
AI.method: 法律分析和判例研究，通过分析相关法律条文和先前判决。
AI.findings: 法院认定作品必须由人类创作才能获得版权保护，因此AI生成作品无法注册版权。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了版权法中"作者"概念仅限于人类，探讨了宪法对国会修改版权法的限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI生成作品的法律地位提供了重要判例，影响未来相关法律发展和AI创作实践。

title: Strategic Delegation of Moral Decisions to AI
affiliations: New York University School of Law and New York University School of Law

detail.title: Strategic Delegation of Moral Decisions to AI
detail.abstract:
Our study examines how individuals perceive the moral agency of artificial intelligence (AI), and, specifically, whether individuals believe that by using AI as their agent, they can offload to the AI some of their responsibility for a morally sensitive decision. Existing literature shows that people often delegate self-interested decisions to human agents to mitigate their moral responsibility. This research explores whether individuals will similarly delegate such decisions to AI to reduce moral costs. 

Participants (hereinafter, “Allocators”) took part in a dictator game, allocating a $10 endowment between themselves and a Recipient. In the experimental treatment, Allocators could involve ChatGPT in their allocation decision, at the cost of incurring added time to complete the experiment. When engaged, the AI executed the transfer by informing the Recipient of a necessary payment code. Around 35% of Allocators chose to involve the AI, despite the opportunity costs of a much-prolonged process.

To isolate the effect of the AI’s perceived responsibility, a control condition replaced the AI with a non-agentive computer program, while maintaining identical decision protocols. 

Allocators who involved the AI transferred significantly less money to the Recipient, suggesting that delegating the transfer to AI reduced the moral costs associated with self-interested decisions. Prosocial individuals, who face higher moral costs from violating a norm, were significantly more likely to involve the AI than proself individuals.  A responsibility measure indicates that Allocators who attributed more responsibility to the AI were also more likely to involve the AI. 

The study suggests that AI systems provide human actors with an easily accessible, low-cost, and hard-to-monitor means of offloading personal moral responsibility, highlighting the need to consider in AI regulation not only the inherent risks of AI output, but also how AI’s perceived moral agency can influence human behavior and ethical accountability in human-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，人们会通过将道德敏感决策委托给AI来减轻自身的道德责任。在独裁者游戏中，35%的参与者选择使用ChatGPT来执行资金分配，这些参与者分配给对方的金额显著减少，表明AI委托降低了自私决策的道德成本。亲社会个体更倾向于使用AI，且将更多责任归因于AI的参与者更可能使用AI。
AI.research_question: 个体是否相信通过使用AI作为代理人，可以将道德敏感决策的责任转移给AI？
AI.motivation: 现有文献显示人们经常将自利决策委托给人类代理人以减轻道德责任，本研究探讨个体是否也会类似地将此类决策委托给AI来减少道德成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德责任转移理论、委托代理理论、AI道德代理感知
AI.method: 采用独裁者游戏实验设计，参与者分配10美元资金给自己和接收者。实验组可选择使用ChatGPT参与分配决策，控制组使用非代理性计算机程序。
AI.findings: 35%的参与者选择使用AI，尽管有时间成本；使用AI的参与者分配给接收者的金额显著减少；亲社会个体比自利个体更可能使用AI；将更多责任归因于AI的参与者更可能使用AI。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了道德责任转移理论到AI领域，揭示了AI作为道德代理人的作用机制，为理解人机交互中的道德责任分配提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了AI系统为人类提供了易于获取、低成本且难以监控的道德责任转移手段，强调了AI监管需要考虑AI感知道德代理对人类行为和伦理责任的影响。

title: Regional Government Consumption and Investment Multipliers

detail.title: Regional Government Consumption and Investment Multipliers
detail.abstract: This paper is the first to use the regional fiscal multipliers framework to separately identify government consumption and investment multipliers. I run panel IV regressions on a U.S. state-level dataset, constructed from transaction-level data on U.S. federal military procurement contracts, and find that regional government consumption multipliers are larger than regional government investment multipliers. Also, spillovers are more negative from government consumption. I interpret these results with a New Keynesian DSGE model of a two-sector, two-region monetary union, with two key mechanisms: (1) investment is more intertemporally substitutable, and (2) consumption exhibits greater home bias. Finally, I estimate a quantitative model of the United States as a 51-region monetary union, to measure the effects of the 2021 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA). While panel estimates of regional multipliers are larger than time-series estimates of aggregate multipliers, the quantitative model yields larger aggregate multipliers than a model that abstracts from sectoral or regional differences.

AI.tldr: 本文首次使用区域财政乘数框架分别识别政府消费和投资乘数。基于美国联邦军事采购合同数据的面板IV回归显示，区域政府消费乘数大于投资乘数，且政府消费的溢出效应更负面。通过新凯恩斯DSGE模型解释，投资更具跨期替代性，消费更具本土偏好。最后估算2021年基础设施投资和就业法案的影响，发现考虑区域和部门差异的模型得出更大的总乘数。
AI.research_question: 区域政府消费乘数和投资乘数有何差异？
AI.motivation: 首次使用区域财政乘数框架分别识别政府消费和投资乘数，填补现有研究空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯DSGE模型，两部门两区域货币联盟
AI.method: 面板IV回归，基于美国联邦军事采购合同数据构建州级数据集
AI.findings: 区域政府消费乘数大于投资乘数，政府消费的溢出效应更负面
AI.theory_contributions: 提出投资更具跨期替代性和消费更具本土偏好两个关键机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为2021年基础设施投资和就业法案提供政策评估，显示考虑区域差异的模型得出更大总乘数

reference: Fordham Law Review, Volume 94, Pp. 441-455
title: Cultural Property Protection As A National Security Enforcement Priority
affiliations: Steptoe LLP

detail.title: Cultural Property Protection As A National Security Enforcement Priority
detail.abstract: This essay argues that U.S. enforcement against the trafficking of looted art and antiquities is most effective when treated as a national security enforcement priority, as this area has been treated over the course of a century. Drawing on historical precedents, including Nazi-era restitution efforts and modern sanctions enforcement, the essay highlights the need for interagency coordination among law enforcement, intelligence, and diplomatic bodies. Despite past successes, current approaches remain ad hoc and under-resourced. The essay calls for a formalized national security framework to address cultural property crimes, especially in conflict zones like Ukraine, where looting threatens geopolitical stability. Such a shift would enhance investigative capacity and uphold international cultural heritage protections.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将美国打击掠夺艺术品和古董贩运作为国家安全执法优先事项最为有效，需要跨部门协调，并呼吁建立正式的国家安全框架来处理文化遗产犯罪。
AI.research_question: 如何最有效地打击掠夺艺术品和古董的贩运？
AI.motivation: 当前打击文化遗产犯罪的方法零散且资源不足，特别是在乌克兰等冲突地区，掠夺行为威胁地缘政治稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家安全框架、历史先例（纳粹时代归还努力、现代制裁执法）、跨部门协调理论
AI.method: 历史分析、案例研究（纳粹时代和现代冲突地区）、政策分析
AI.findings: 将文化遗产犯罪作为国家安全优先事项处理最为有效，需要执法、情报和外交机构的协调合作
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将文化遗产保护纳入国家安全框架的理论基础，强调了跨部门协调的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立正式的国家安全框架来应对文化遗产犯罪，增强调查能力，维护国际文化遗产保护

title: "일본 하청법에 대한 비교법적 검토" 자문 의견서 (A Comparative Legal Analysis of Japan's Subcontract Act: Advisory Opinion Report)
affiliations: Kyoto University - Graduate School of Law

detail.title: "일본 하청법에 대한 비교법적 검토" 자문 의견서 (A Comparative Legal Analysis of Japan's Subcontract Act: Advisory Opinion Report)
detail.abstract:
Korean Abstract: 본 의견서는 「하도급법의 역외적용 관련 정책 방향에 대한 연구」(공정거래위원회, 기업거래정책과, 2024. 9)의 일환으로 수행된 자문 결과로서, 한국 하도급법과의 비교 관점에서 일본 하청법의 도입 이유, 규율 내용 및 역외 적용 여부에 관한 검토 의견을 담고 있습니다. 

English Abstract: This advisory opinion report was prepared as part of the study titled “Policy Directions on the Extraterritorial Application of the Subcontracting Act” (Korea Fair Trade Commission, September 2024). It presents a comparative legal analysis of Japan’s Subcontract Act in relation to Korea’s Subcontracting Transactions Fairness Act.

Specifically, the advisory report examines (i) the rationale behind Japan’s introduction of the Subcontract Act, (ii) the substantive provisions governing the abuse of superior bargaining position—particularly in subcontracting relationships—and (iii) the potential for the extraterritorial application of both the Antimonopoly Act (especially the provision prohibiting abuse of superior bargaining position) and the Subcontract Act.

The study aims to shed light on Japan’s regulatory design and enforcement approach, drawing policy implications for Korea’s ongoing discussions on the international reach of its subcontracting supply chain and the possible extraterritorial application of the Subcontracting Act. 

Note: Downloadable document is in Korean.

AI.tldr: 本报告对日本分包法与韩国分包法的比较分析，重点研究日本分包法的引入背景、规制内容及域外适用可能性，为韩国分包法域外适用政策提供参考。
AI.research_question: 日本分包法的引入背景、规制内容及其域外适用可能性如何？对韩国分包法域外适用政策有何启示？
AI.motivation: 为韩国公平交易委员会关于分包法域外适用政策方向的研究提供比较法分析参考，借鉴日本在分包交易规制方面的经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法分析框架，聚焦于滥用优势地位理论在分包关系中的适用，以及法律域外效力的理论基础。
AI.method: 比较法律分析方法，通过系统比较日本分包法与韩国分包法的规制体系、适用范围和执法机制。
AI.findings: 日本分包法主要规制分包关系中的滥用优势地位行为，其反垄断法（特别是滥用优势地位条款）和分包法在特定条件下可能具有域外适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对分包交易中滥用优势地位规制理论的理解，为法律域外适用理论在分包法领域的应用提供了实证分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国制定分包法域外适用政策提供了日本经验借鉴，有助于完善韩国分包供应链的国际规制框架。

title: No More Lost Maradonas? The Impact of Mexico's Youth Quota on Playing Participation
affiliations: CREMA, University of Lucerne and University of Barcelona - Barcelona Institute of Economics (IEB)

detail.title: No More Lost Maradonas? The Impact of Mexico's Youth Quota on Playing Participation
detail.abstract: The governing body of the Mexican Football Association introduced an age-based quota (2005-2011) in the country's top division, Liga MX, to improve national youth talent. Leveraging a unique hand-collected dataset, we exploit the implementation of the quota as an exogenous shock and analyze its causal effects on the participation of youth players at the top professional level. We apply two-way fixed effects DiD regressions and find that the quota increased youth playing time and broadened field experience significantly, indicating the quota might prevent losing hidden talent: "Lost Maradonas". Importantly, these effects were not concentrated among a few individuals and persisted in high-stakes matches, where the regulation did not apply.

AI.tldr: 本文利用墨西哥足球协会2005-2011年实施的年龄配额政策作为外生冲击，通过双重差分模型分析发现该政策显著增加了年轻球员在顶级联赛的上场时间和比赛经验，可能防止了"失落的马拉多纳"现象，且效果在不受规管的高风险比赛中依然持续。
AI.research_question: 年龄配额政策对墨西哥顶级足球联赛中年轻球员参与度的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 墨西哥足球协会引入年龄配额政策旨在改善国家青年人才发展，但需要评估该政策是否真正促进了年轻球员的职业发展机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外生政策冲击的因果推断框架，运用制度理论和人才发展理论分析配额政策对球员发展的影响。
AI.method: 利用手工收集的独特数据集，采用双向固定效应双重差分回归方法分析配额政策的因果效应。
AI.findings: 配额政策显著增加了年轻球员的上场时间和比赛经验广度，效果不仅限于少数个体，且在不受规管的高风险比赛中持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 为体育人才发展政策评估提供了因果证据，深化了对制度干预如何影响职业运动员发展的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为足球协会和其他体育组织制定青年人才发展政策提供了实证依据，证明年龄配额政策能有效防止潜在天才球员的流失。

title: The Invisible Separation of Powers and the Control of the Central Political Power. Lessons from Hungary, Moldova and Romania

detail.title: The Invisible Separation of Powers and the Control of the Central Political Power. Lessons from Hungary, Moldova and Romania

keywords: Control of the Central Political Power

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for publication in: Martin Belov (ed.): Populist Constitutionalism and Illiberal Democracies. Between Constitutional Imagination, Normative Entrenchment and Political Reality (Intersentia, 2021)

detail.abstract: The diversity of concepts and interpretations of the separation of powers leads to the argument that when examining the proper functioning of this principle not only the institutional design of state institutions and their formal powers shall be taken into consideration. The first hypothesis of this research paper is that a number of legal institutions, procedures and doctrines have primary functions which are not explicitly related to the system of the separation of powers but have a significant (secondary) impact on the relations of state organs, especially on the room of manoeuvre of the majoritarian political power. Certain tools of direct democracy (citizens' initiatives, referenda initiated by a minority), internal limits of the legislative power (open debate, supermajority requirements), the application of certain doctrines developed in constitutional interpretation (informal constitutional amendments, the basic structure doctrine), judicial enforcement of political rights (the right to vote, the freedom of expression, the freedom of assembly) as well as certain norms of and actions performed under international legal orders (dispute resolution before international fora) can limit the sphere of action of state organs, especially the majoritarian political power. If we accept the limitation of the exercise of the central (majoritarian) political power as the basic function of the doctrine, these effects can be taken into consideration within the complex frame of the separation of powers as control mechanisms, as 'invisible checks and balances'. Therefore, as the secondary effects of these legal institutions, procedures and doctrines can be interrelated, it also can be conceptualized an ’invisible layer’ of the system of separation of powers. Of course, the central political power can react on the limiting effect of these institutions – counteractions are not necessary, but likely to occur.

detail.abstract: In light of the rapid digital revolution taking place in the modern workplace, this article examines and discusses the evolving nature of the employee-employer relationship from an Indian perspective, paying special attention to how artificial intelligence (AI) is affecting workers' job happiness and the psychological relationship they carry with their employer. The data is retrieved from 321 Indian employees through a digital survey, and then statistical analysis is carried out to understand the psychological basis and impacts of their behaviour in relation to integrating AI at work. Therefore, the evidence suggests that AI adoption is positively correlated with job satisfaction levels; however, when transformational leadership tendencies are connected with psychological contracts, this positive correlation is diminished.

detail.abstract: We estimate the long-term consequences of math and reading rank within an elementary school on short and long-term outcomes. We find that higher rank leads to better outcomes. Students ranked at the top in grade 7 perform up to 0.33 standard deviations higher on future school exams, are more likely to graduate high school and university, and earn significantly more at age 28. Math rank is especially predictive of high school completion and income. Reading rank is more strongly associated with university graduation. We find differences in the effect of rank on trajectories by gender for both top and bottom ranks. Our findings suggest that classroom position, even conditional on ability, has persistent effects, with implications for equity and early intervention.

AI.tldr: 本研究估计了小学阶段数学和阅读排名对短期和长期结果的影响，发现较高排名会带来更好的结果。七年级排名靠前的学生在未来学校考试中表现更好，更可能完成高中和大学教育，并在28岁时收入显著更高。数学排名对高中完成率和收入预测性更强，阅读排名与大学毕业更相关。排名影响存在性别差异。

detail.title: The GATT vs Inflation: Tokyo Drift

detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates that ignoring the source of variation in tariff levels yields misleading conclusions regarding the effects of tariff changes. Specifically, we show that changes in the ad valorem equivalent (AVE) tariff are insufficient to quantify the magnitude or sign of the effect of tariff changes on economic outcomes. To illustrate this point, we construct the first database of annual US statutory tariffs from 1972 to 1988 and use it to explore the consequences of liberalization in the years spanning the Tokyo Round of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). Decomposing the aggregate AVE into its statutory and endogenous components, we document two distinct liberalizations in our sample. Prior to 1979, inflation combines with specific tariffs to create an ``accidental liberalization'', despite the absence of widespread statutory tariff changes. After 1979, endogenous changes in the composition of imports mask the large Tokyo Round statutory tariff liberalization. Generalizing an exact hat framework to accommodate specific tariffs, we show that inflation-driven reductions in AVEs account for roughly half of the tariff liberalization in our sample, but these changes ultimately reduce imports and welfare. Finally, we show that specific tariffs remain an important determinant of cross-sectional variation in AVEs: between 2000 and 2017, one-third to one-half of the annual cross-sectional variance in good-level AVEs is driven by variation in the AVE of specific tariffs.

AI.tldr: 本文证明忽略关税水平变化来源会得出关于关税变化影响的误导性结论。研究发现从价等值关税变化不足以量化关税变化对经济结果的影响程度或方向。通过构建1972-1988年美国法定关税数据库，发现样本期间存在两种不同的自由化：1979年前通胀与从量关税导致"意外自由化"，1979年后进口构成的内生变化掩盖了东京回合法定关税自由化。
AI.research_question: 关税变化的来源如何影响我们对关税自由化经济效应的理解？

title: Rights-Based Development: Implications for NGOs
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Rights-Based Development: Implications for NGOs
detail.abstract:
This article examines how the rapid spread of rights-based approaches (RBAs) to development has transformed the global NGO landscape. Over the past two decades, bilateral donors, multilateral agencies, and civil society organizations have increasingly embedded human rights principles into the theory and practice of international development. Drawing on over 120 interviews across 60 countries and extensive network analysis, Kindornay, Ron, and Carpenter provide one of the first empirical assessments of how this shift is reshaping the structure, funding, and strategies of development NGOs.


The authors argue that the rights-based paradigm has triggered a deep organizational merger between the human rights and development communities, creating both new opportunities and new hierarchies. Their framework identifies five testable hypotheses about NGO adaptation, including changes in advocacy priorities, donor relationships, and accountability mechanisms. The study highlights the role of Northern donors such as DFID, SIDA, and NORAD, international NGOs like Oxfam and CARE, and local Southern partners in operationalizing rights-based programming.


By mapping this global cascade of rights-based discourse, the article provides crucial insights into the political economy of human rights, the evolution of transnational advocacy networks, and the enduring tensions between service delivery and rights-based empowerment. The authors call for further research on how RBAs influence NGO legitimacy, aid effectiveness, and local participation.

detail.abstract: We provide the first global, long-run analysis of how governments fund and de-fund military spending. Constructing a panel of 167 countries from 1817 to 2024, we estimate fiscal responses to armaments and disarmaments, including wartime shifts. Deficit spending is the primary financing policy, while larger armaments trigger deeper cuts to civilian spending. Fiscal space is a critical moderator: low-debt countries rely mainly on borrowing, whereas high-debt countries resort to taxation and budget reallocations. Armaments and disarma-ments have asymmetric effects: disarmaments only partially reverse prior poli-cies, sustaining elevated civilian spending as a fiscal peace dividend and leaving the state permanently larger.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对全球范围内政府如何资助和削减军费开支进行了长期分析，构建了1817-2024年167个国家的面板数据，评估了军备和裁军（包括战时转变）的财政反应。研究发现赤字支出是主要融资政策，而更大的军备会引发对民用支出的更深度削减。财政空间是关键调节因素：低债务国家主要依赖借贷，而高债务国家则诉诸税收和预算重新分配。军备和裁军具有不对称效应：裁军仅部分逆转先前政策，维持较高的民用支出作为财政和平红利，使国家规模永久性扩大。
